name: Morimiya Aoi
source:
A young woman who offers her services as a security guard to help deal with the Yokai.
She seems to be familiar with these creatures - she knows that they never lie, for instance - and takes the search very seriously.
Maybe she has some kind of history with the building or with Yokai..
